examples.japanese: 音楽を聞きながら勉強します。
examples.reading: おんがくをききながらべんきょうします。
examples.gloss: I study while listening to music.

examples.japanese: ご飯を食べながらテレビを見る。
examples.reading: ごはんをたべながらテレビをみる。

usage: Both actions are done by the same person at the same time.
The main action is the last verb. The ながら clause is the background action: in 歩きながら話す the talking is the point.
It cannot join two different subjects. Use a clause with 間 or と同時に instead.

compare.difference: て joins actions in sequence or as a list. ながら means two actions at once.
